title: cup warmer
text:
cup warmer. This is a great cup warmer as cup warmers go... Christmas decor (green tree version)
PROS
-No on/off switch - comes on with the weight of the cup
-keeps liquid warmish - but not hot (which may be a "con" for some folks). A warmer isn't really designed to keep liquids scalding hot - just warm
-easy to clean smooth cup area. Clean by moist wipe - when cool, not hot
-festive holiday print - I'll use year round
CONS
-pretty big foot print - if you have a smaller area, this is gonna be a challenge... about 5 1/2" across the middle of circle
There is a black cord to plug in - about 3ft or so long. The warmer has a lit ring that is lit when there is weight on the warmer - activating the the warmer which gets pretty hot - but does keep liquids warmish - not hot. The other thing to note is that you will need a flat bottom cup. It will not warm any cup that isn't fully flat on the warmer.
- The bottom of the warmer is plastic and will be slippery on other plastic surfaces. I tried to put some of that rubber webbing underneath, but the warmer won't turn on because the weight of the cup of presses a tiny button on the bottom of the unit doesn't reach the surface you set it on - and therefore wont turn on. This is the biggest challenge so far.
Over all, in my opinion, it works as I'd expected. I hate to drink tepid coffee or tea - this does make it warmer than tepid. The less liquid that it is in the cup, the warmer it will be (captain obvious - right?). To me, this is a nice quality warmer for a reasonable price. Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
